summary: Arq, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 5.02 announcing the appointment of Shimon Steinmetz as Executive Vice President and CFO, effective on or before July 27, 2026. Mr. Steinmetz, with experience at Alvarez & Marsal and Finjan Holdings, will receive a $500,000 base salary, short-term and long-term incentive targets, and inducement awards including 250,000 restricted stock awards and 150,000 performance share units tied to stock price targets ($8/$10/$15) over three years. This is a routine executive appointment with compensatory arrangements, not a forced departure or special-situation event.
